title: Smallness of perfect restriction classes
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes in universe $u$ [def-pc-derived-category], $f:Y\to X$ an open immersion, and $W\subseteq f(Y)$ an open of $X$. Assume $P_w(X,W)$ [def-pc-perfect-classes-small-on-open]. For any derived categories in morphism universe $w$ on $Y$ and all its localized open sites, the skeleton of the full subcategory given by $P_{f^{-1}W}$ [def-perfect-gluing-endpoint-properties] is $u$-small. This is the restriction image of perfect quasi-coherent objects, not smallness of global gluing classes.

source.place: Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star; Step 2 of lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set, using Tag 08DR

proof.text: Put A = f⁻¹W. Regard Modules.overEquiv A as an equivalence between the shared module-sheaf categories. Transport the supplied localization on the localized site across its cochain-complex equivalence: composing the complex equivalence with Q is a localization by Functor.IsLocalization.of_equivalence_source. Its target retains morphism universe w. Supply all further localizations on A.toScheme using nonempty_derivedOpenLocalization.

Mathlib opensRange_comp, opensRange_ι and image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf identify the image of A.ι ≫ f with W using hW. Apply pW to this open immersion with the constructed localizations. This gives a u-small skeleton of perfect objects inside the quasi-coherent derived category of A.toScheme.

For exact restriction followed by Modules.overEquiv, Modules.overFunctorEquiv identifies the module functor with ordinary open restriction. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor pullback with the same functor. Transport finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation from the exact over functor. The IsLeftDerivedFunctor witness of exists_derivedPullback and Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts show that derived pullback is isomorphic to the mapDerivedCategory of this exact composite, by leftDerivedUnique. Apply derivedPullback_preserve_perfect to A.ι and transport the perfect local witnesses through the resulting isomorphism.

For a perfect quasi-coherent E, SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_over preserves quasi-coherence in every cohomological degree. schemeDerivedQCoh_openRestriction_iff therefore proves quasi-coherence of the exact derived restriction to A.toScheme. The derived composition comparison identifies this restriction with the derived over-equivalence applied to the localized restriction.

An object of the restriction family is isomorphic to the restriction of such an E. Transport the quasi-coherent and perfect properties across that isomorphism, using homologyFunctor.mapIso and restriction.mapIso. Lift the composite of the full inclusion and derived over-equivalence first into the quasi-coherent full subcategory and then into its perfect full subcategory. Both lifts are fully faithful. The induced map on skeletons is injective; small_of_injective into the small skeleton supplied by pW proves the conclusion. All constructions allow A empty or total.
